gaps.current: FAIL on all 6 apps. Path: /apps/nucleisky/ for a biologist with a Z-stack: reads the summary 'Align microscopy images in 2D and 3D...' and About ('calibrated similarity transform', 'landmark constellations'), then finds nothing more. I searched every app page's text for TIFF, OME, CSV, input, output, mask, table, plot, limitation, requirement, example, Works with, Produces: no app page has any of them (hits for 'format' and 'report' are only the downloads-table header and 'Report a problem'; the one 'Produces' hit is in LabConstrictor Demo's description). The facts exist only in the app repositories. NucleiSky docs/2D/data_preparation.md says the 2D pipeline 'strictly requires 2D arrays... Any non-2D stack layout (Z, Y, X)... raises a ValueError', README 'Golden Rule 1' says missing or wrong pixel size makes alignment fail, and docs/exports.md names the outputs (transform JSON, aligned_on_full_px.tif, overlay PNG). CellTracksColab README says 'Required File Format: CSV or XML files' (TrackMate) and 'does not yet support track merging or splitting', and links test datasets on Zenodo. None of this reaches the site because schema/labconstrictor-app.schema.json has no inputs/outputs/limitations/example-data field (properties: name, summary, description, quickstart, kind, hosts, distribution, authors, license, categories, doi, homepage, docs_url, icon, screenshots), and pages_apps.page_app (lines 189-208) renders only description. Only 1 of 6 apps has any screenshot, and it is a repo banner ('NucleiSky banner.', alt=""), not an interface or result image (shots/t2-nucleisky-full.png, t2-celltrackscolab-full.png, t2-vlab4mic-full.png).
gaps.proposal: Add three optional manifest fields, each a short array of plain-text strings with a length cap: `inputs` (data types, dimensionality, required metadata such as pixel size), `outputs`, `limitations` (maximum 4 items, 140 characters each, same style as `quickstart`). Render them in page_app right after the badges and before 'Get it' as 'Works with', 'Produces', 'Limits'. When a field is absent show an explicit 'Not stated by the authors' line (same convention as License: 'Not stated'), so a visitor can tell 'not given' from 'not shown'. Index the three fields in cards.search_text so 'TIFF' or 'Z-stack' find apps. Then the app authors fill them from their own docs: NucleiSky from docs/2D/data_preparation.md and docs/limitations.md, CellTracksColab from the README format table. Update the schema copy in the template (src-template/.tools/schema), the initialiser form schema and the template's app-manifest guide so new apps are asked for them.
gaps.rule_conflicts: No conflict with author-controlled: authors expose only what they choose, and the page says so visibly. The benchmark's 'strongly enforced for analysis apps' would conflict with that principle, so do not make the fields required; show 'Not stated by the authors' instead. Keep text through text.esc. A new page block needs a pattern in DESIGN.md first. The new fields are manifest fields, so no second description is kept here.
